correctness.rationale: Longitude integration makes the four real azimuthal sectors orthogonal for both energies and makes the sine and cosine modes contribute the same scalar at each nonzero order. The cap-to-full ratio is the integral from t to 1 divided by that from 0 to 1 of the even squared associated Legendre density. The four polynomials and trace 7(1−t) check exactly. The first three pairwise gaps change sign or vanish only as shown by the factors 5t²−1 and 5t²−3; all gaps to order 3 are positive on (0,1), including the one with quartic 15(t²−2/5)²+13/5. The signs give every asserted ordering, and evaluation at the two squared cutoffs yields the stated five- and three-dimensional top eigenspaces and eigenvalues. Positivity on the interior makes the restriction injective and yields the stated square root condition number. Independent exact reconstruction from Cartesian harmonic basis polynomials and evaluation at both algebraic cutoffs agreed: python3 /workspace/reproductions/frozen_checks.py 5.

evidence: The earlier normalized beta weight is w_d(s)=s⁻¹ᐟ²(1−s)^((d−3)/2)/B(1/2,(d−1)/2), with densities s((d+2)s−3)², (1−s)((d+2)s−1)², s(1−s)² and (1−s)³.
It gives four exact gap formulas; at d=3 its prefactor becomes t(1−t²)/2, with s=t².
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Substitute d=3 and s=z² in the integrals to obtain precisely the four polynomial densities in z of the frozen proof. Substitute d=3 and s=t² in the gap identities: for example λ₀−λ₁ becomes (7/16)t(1−t²)(5t²−1)(5t²−3), and λ₂−λ₃ becomes (35/16)t(1−t²)³. The remaining gaps follow by adding differences, including λ₀−λ₃ with the strictly positive quartic. Hence the complete ordering and strict minimum follow from the prior formulas, and evaluation and taking the singular-value ratio are mechanical.

Its theorem explicitly gives both transitions and maximizing spaces, including the first top multiplicity d(d+1)/2−1. At d=3 and earlier squared cutoff s=t², these are exactly the fivefold and threefold resonances here. The four spectral branches, full ordering, least branch, crossing values and condition number are determined directly by its exact general spectral formulas; expanding the polynomials is not a new mathematical result.
